title: Romanticism & the Sublime
description: Nature at its most awe-inspiring, and the human drama set against it.
source: Art Institute of Chicago, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: Distant View of Niagara Falls
items.description_narrative: Two figures stand on a rocky outcrop framed by blazing autumn foliage, looking out over the falls as mist rises into a brooding sky. The horseshoe of falling water glows pale against dark storm clouds gathering above the gorge. The painting depicts Niagara Falls.
items.tags: niagara falls, autumn foliage, waterfall, sublime landscape, oil painting, hudson river school

items.title: New England Scenery
items.cultural_context: Hudson River School, American Romanticism, 19th Century American
items.description_narrative: A wagon crosses a small wooden bridge in the valley below, dwarfed by a rocky outcrop and a sweeping tree that frames the foreground. A white church steeple rises among distant farms, the whole rolling landscape bathed in the soft glow of a setting sun.
items.tags: pastoral landscape, sunset, bridge, church steeple, oil painting

items.title: Pergola with Oranges
items.medium: Oil on paper, mounted on canvas
items.description_narrative: Sunlight dapples a stone-pillared walkway lined with orange trees heavy with fruit, their shadows raking across the pale columns. A terracotta pot of pink roses sits in the foreground, while a lone figure in white pauses near an archway at the far end of the path.
items.tags: pergola, orange trees, garden, sunlight, oil painting, architecture

items.title: Coming Squall (Nahant Beach with a Summer Shower)
items.cultural_context: Early American Landscape Painting, American Romanticism
items.medium: Oil on canvas mounted on cradled panel
items.description_narrative: A curling wave breaks along a rocky beach as gulls skim low over the water, a lone sailboat cutting through the swell farther out. Above, towering clouds trail visible streaks of rain toward the horizon while sunlight still catches the wet sand underfoot.
items.tags: seascape, storm clouds, beach, sailboat, birds, oil painting

items.title: Summit of the Sierras
items.medium: Gouache over graphite, on cream laid paper
items.description_narrative: A wind-bent pine clings to a rocky outcrop in the foreground, dwarfed by row upon row of jagged, snow-capped peaks fading into the mist. A lone bird glides through the vast space between the near cliff and the distant range.
items.tags: sierra nevada, mountains, snow peaks, gouache, wilderness, sublime landscape

items.title: Landscape with Dog
items.description_narrative: A white hunting dog stands alert on a wooded path, one paw raised as if pointing toward something beyond the frame. Autumn-tinged leaves frame a hazy view of distant hills and water beneath a cloud-streaked sky.
items.tags: dog, hunting dog, forest, autumn, oil painting, animal art

items.title: Fishing Boats with Hucksters Bargaining for Fish
items.description_narrative: A crowded fishing boat rides choppy swells, its pale sail billowing as figures gather around baskets on deck. A small rowboat drifts nearby while another vessel works the water in the distance, storm clouds breaking open to a patch of blue sky.
items.tags: fishing boats, seascape, choppy sea, marine art, oil painting, dramatic sky

items.title: Valley of Aosta: Snowstorm, Avalanche, and Thunderstorm
items.description_narrative: A vortex of storm and snow engulfs the mountains, pale avalanche clouds cascading down dark, jagged peaks. In the lower corner, tiny figures huddle together with scattered belongings and a dog, dwarfed by the churning violence above. The painting depicts a snowstorm and avalanche in the Aosta Valley.
items.tags: avalanche, snowstorm, sublime landscape, oil painting, turbulent sky, dramatic scale

items.title: Wanderer above the Sea of Fog
items.description_narrative: Seen from behind, a man stands atop a rocky summit, cane in hand, gazing out over a vast sea of fog. Jagged rock formations pierce the mist on either side, their peaks the only solid ground in an otherwise dissolving landscape. The painting depicts a man standing on a mountain.
items.tags: solitary figure, fog, mountains, oil painting, sublime, back view

items.title: Liberty Leading the People
items.description_narrative: A bare-breasted woman strides over a barricade of rubble, tricolor flag raised high in one hand and a musket in the other, leading a ragged crowd of armed men. Fallen figures lie in the foreground as smoke drifts toward a hazy skyline of city rooftops. The painting depicts a Paris uprising at a barricade.
items.tags: revolution, allegory, flag, barricade, history painting, oil painting
items.credit_line: Erich Lessing Culture and Fine Arts Archives via artsy.net

items.title: The Raft of the Medusa
items.description_narrative: Survivors cling to a raft's makeshift mast and rigging, straining to wave cloth at a ship barely visible on the horizon. Lifeless bodies are strewn across the foreground planks as churning waves and a stormy, streaked sky close in around the raft. The painting depicts survivors adrift after a shipwreck.
items.tags: shipwreck, survival, disaster, oil painting, dramatic, dark palette

items.title: The Nightmare
items.description_narrative: A woman in white lies sprawled backward across a bed, one arm hanging limp toward the floor. A squat, grinning incubus crouches on her chest while a wild-eyed, ghostly horse head pushes through the curtains behind them, its pale form glowing against the darkness. The painting depicts a nightmare brought on by sleep paralysis.
items.tags: gothic, nightmare, incubus, dream, dark background, oil painting

items.title: The Hay Wain
items.description_narrative: A horse-drawn wagon fords a shallow river beside a weathered thatched cottage, its walls softened by climbing vines. A small dog watches from the bank as towering clouds pile up over the open meadow beyond, sunlight breaking through in patches.
items.tags: rural landscape, cottage, river, wagon, dog, oil painting

items.title: Rain, Steam and Speed - The Great Western Railway
items.description_narrative: A dark locomotive plunges through swirling rain and mist, its form dissolving into loose, energetic brushstrokes that blur the boundary between sky and track. A stone arched bridge crosses the river at left, tiny figures barely visible in the haze below. The painting depicts a locomotive crossing a railway bridge over the River Thames.
items.tags: locomotive, railway, rain, motion, oil painting, industrial

items.title: The Fighting Temeraire
items.description_narrative: A ghostly pale sailing ship, its masts bare, is towed by a small dark steam tug trailing black smoke across a blazing sunset. The moon hangs faint in the pale sky opposite, the whole scene mirrored in the still water below. The painting depicts the warship HMS Temeraire.
items.tags: sunset, ship, steam tug, maritime, oil painting, twilight

items.title: The Death of Sardanapalus
items.description_narrative: A bearded ruler reclines impassively on a crimson bed strewn with jewels and fine fabric, watching the chaos unfold around him. Below, a soldier grips a struggling nude woman while a horse and jumbled riches crowd the shadowy foreground, the whole scene lit in deep reds and golds.
items.tags: chaos, violence, richly colored, dramatic, oil painting, orientalism

items.title: Women of Algiers in their Apartment
items.description_narrative: Two seated women in flowing robes are rendered in graphite, one hunched forward with her face turned down, the other reclining against a bolster with her feet bare. Faint foxing spots speckle the aged paper around the two figure studies.
items.tags: drawing, graphite, figure study, sketch, seated figures
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the National Gallery of Art. Please see the Gallery's Open Access Policy.
items.current_repository: drawings in the National Gallery of Art

items.title: The Cornfield
items.description_narrative: A dog herds a small flock of sheep along a sunken lane between towering trees, while a figure lies at the bank's edge in the shade. Loose, textured brushstrokes capture dappled light breaking through the leaves toward a hazy view of open fields beyond.
items.tags: rural landscape, sheep, dog, lane, trees, oil sketch, pastoral

items.title: The Charging Chasseur
items.description_narrative: A cavalry officer on a rearing white horse twists in his saddle, saber raised and cloak billowing, a leopard-skin cloth draped beneath him. Smoke and distant troops fill the background, the horse's wild eye and flared nostrils echoing the tension of the charge.
items.tags: cavalry, military, horse, dynamic pose, battle scene, oil painting, romanticism

items.title: The Combat of the Giaour and Hassan
items.description_narrative: Two horsemen in flowing robes clash mid-charge, one raising a pistol, the other a curved sword, their mounts rearing amid churning dust. Below them a fallen fighter is pinned to the ground, while smoke and more riders fill the distance. The painting depicts a battle inspired by Lord Byron's poem The Giaour.
items.tags: battle scene, horses, orientalism, combat, dynamic, oil painting

items.title: Lion Hunt
items.description_narrative: Lions maul a fallen horse and a struggling hunter at close range while mounted riders wheel and thrust spears into the fray. The chaotic tangle of bodies, blades, and manes fills the foreground beneath a turbulent, cloud-heavy sky.
items.tags: lion hunt, chaos, orientalism, dynamic composition, oil painting, dramatic

items.title: Friar Pedro Shoots El Maragato as His Horse Runs Off
items.description_narrative: A robed friar fires a smoking pistol at close range as a man in yellow breeches staggers backward, arms flung wide. Behind them a grey horse bolts across the bare landscape, its rider's spot suddenly empty.
items.tags: gunshot, confrontation, horse, dramatic scene, oil on panel, narrative painting

items.title: Peasants Bringing Home a Calf Born in the Fields
items.description_narrative: Two farmhands carry a newborn calf on a bed of straw between them, while its mother follows close behind, straining toward her calf. Children peer out from a stone farmhouse doorway as the group makes its way home along a dirt path.
items.tags: rural life, farm, calf, oil painting, genre scene, countryside

items.title: Stoke-by-Nayland
items.description_narrative: A horse-drawn cart stands harnessed near a farm gate, a dog and figures resting in the shade of tall, wind-tossed trees. In the distance, a church tower rises above a cluster of cottages beneath a vast, cloud-filled sky. The painting depicts Stoke-by-Nayland.
items.tags: rural landscape, church tower, farm cart, oil painting, dramatic sky

items.title: Alpine Scene
items.description_narrative: Slender pine trunks rise in tight ranks, their canopy opening to a pale sky where a hazy valley stretches into the distance. A lone traveler in red, tiny against the scale of the forest, pauses near a stump on the sunlit path ahead.
items.tags: pine forest, landscape, alpine, sublime, oil painting, atmospheric perspective, solitary figure

items.title: The Storm
items.description_narrative: A barefoot couple runs together, holding a billowing golden cloth over their heads as shelter from the wind. Her sheer white dress and his bare torso are caught mid-motion against a dark, stormy sky streaked with a flash of light.
items.tags: couple, running, wind, storm, academic art, oil painting
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: The Third of May 1808
items.description_narrative: Arms thrown wide, a man in a white shirt faces a line of soldiers with raised rifles, a lantern on the ground the only source of light in the near-total darkness. Bloodied bodies lie sprawled in the foreground, while more condemned men wait their turn on the hillside beyond.
items.tags: execution, night scene, dark palette, historical painting, oil painting, dramatic lighting
items.credit_line: This file was derived from: El Tres de Mayo, by Francisco de Goya, from Prado in Google Earth.jpg:

items.title: The Burial of the Sardine
items.description_narrative: A raucous crowd in masks and costume dances beneath a towering black banner painted with a grinning face, trees looming behind them against a bright sky. In the foreground, two women in white spin arm in arm while other revelers sprawl and gather at their feet. The scene depicts a carnival crowd.
items.tags: carnival, masks, crowd scene, festival, oil painting, satire, grotesque
items.current_repository: Real Academia de Bellas Artes de San Fernando, Madrid

items.title: The Doctor
items.description_narrative: Warming his hands over a bowl of glowing coals, a man in a flowing orange-red robe leans on a cane propped against his leg. Two companions in black flat-brimmed hats look on behind him, while open books lie scattered at his feet beneath a bare, wintry tree.
items.tags: genre scene, warming hands, brazier, robe, oil painting, outdoor scene

items.title: Portrait of Doña Isabel de Porcel
items.description_narrative: A woman with chestnut hair gazes to the side, a black lace mantilla framing her face and cascading over her shoulders. Her rose-toned gown, trimmed with dark lace, contrasts with the plain, shadowy background that isolates her figure. The portrait depicts a seated woman wearing a mantilla.
items.tags: portrait, mantilla, spanish fashion, oil painting, elegant

items.title: Allegory of Love (Cupid and Psyche)
items.description_narrative: A winged youth in a flowing red mantle leans over a woman reclining on a pale bed, her arm raised to touch her hair. Dramatic light catches their pale skin against near-total darkness, throwing the two figures into sharp relief while the setting around them stays unseen.
items.tags: nocturne, chiaroscuro, dramatic lighting, reclining figure, winged figure, oil painting, romanticism
items.credit_line: Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya - MNAC, Barcelona

items.title: Boy on a Ram
items.description_narrative: A boy in a wide white hat and rose-trimmed jacket sits astride a dark, curl-horned ram, a small bell hanging from its collar. He raises a switch in one hand while the ram plants its hooves on a sandy path, hazy blue hills rolling away behind them.
items.tags: childhood, portrait, ram, pastoral, oil painting, playful

items.title: Students from the Pestalozzian Academy (fragment)
items.description_narrative: A tightly packed group of boys crowds around a stone workbench, one hammering at a block while another holds a large wooden set square. Behind them, a boy climbs among leafy branches, the whole scene cropped close as if cut from a larger composition.
items.tags: students, education, oil painting, genre scene, children, fragment

items.title: Saint Gregory the Great, Pope
items.description_narrative: A bearded pope, crowned with an ornate triple tiara, bends over a large open book to write with a quill pen. His richly patterned gold and white vestments catch the light against an otherwise plain, dark background. The painting depicts Pope Gregory I.
items.tags: religious portrait, pope, devotional, oil painting, tiara

items.title: A Woman and Two Children by a Fountain
items.description_narrative: A woman in a white headscarf holds a young boy's hand near a stone well, while another boy in a wide hat carries a ceramic jug toward them. Terracotta pitchers rest on the ground beside a rustic thatched building, set against a bright, cloud-filled sky.
items.tags: genre scene, fountain, family, village life, oil painting, rustic

items.title: Scene from the Inquisition
items.description_narrative: Figures in tall conical hats sit before a tribunal of robed judges reading aloud from a book beneath a vaulted, shadowy hall. A single candle illuminates the crowded scene, the packed rows of onlookers fading into darkness at the edges. The painting depicts an auto-da-fé held by the Inquisition.
items.tags: inquisition, tribunal, dark interior, oil painting, historical scene
items.credit_line: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
items.current_repository: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando

items.title: The Baptism of Christ
items.description_narrative: A beam of golden light descends from a white dove overhead, catching the moment a robed figure pours water over the bowed head of a kneeling man at the water's edge. Christ kneels with clasped hands while the other man, draped in red, stands holding a tall reed cross wrapped with a white banner.
items.tags: baptism, biblical scene, dove, chiaroscuro, oil painting, religious art

items.title: The Madhouse
items.description_narrative: Nude and half-dressed men fill a barred, vaulted chamber, some wearing improvised crowns and gesturing wildly while others huddle or lie sprawled on the stone floor. A shaft of light from the high, grated window is the only source of illumination in the shadowy room. The painting depicts the inhabitants of a psychiatric hospital.
items.tags: asylum, psychological, oil on panel, dark interior, social critique, figures
items.credit_line: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
items.current_repository: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando

items.title: The Bewitched Man
items.description_narrative: A man in a wide black hat and long coat pours oil from a jug onto a small flame held by a crouching goblin, his face frozen in alarm. Ghostly, oversized donkeys loom out of the darkness behind him, their pale forms rearing against the gloom.
items.tags: superstition, donkeys, candlelight, dark scene, oil painting, folklore, theatrical

items.title: Portrait of Miguel de Múzquiz y Goyeneche, Count of Gausa
items.description_narrative: An older man in a powdered wig and richly embroidered blue coat stands against a plain dark background, a pale sash crossing his chest and two medals pinned at his breast. He holds a folded, handwritten letter in one hand, his other arm tucked beneath a dark cloak.
items.tags: portrait, nobility, sash, medals, oil painting, formal dress

items.title: Poetry and Poets
items.description_narrative: A laurel-crowned woman in a star-spangled blue mantle sits enthroned on a rocky summit, cherubs at her feet playing a flute, tambourine, and horn. A winged horse rears atop a distant peak at left, while pale, ghostly figures gather in the clouds to either side.
items.tags: allegory, muses, mythological figures, oil painting, cherubs

items.title: Saint Isabel of Portugal Healing the Wounds of a Sick Woman
items.description_narrative: A crowned woman bends over a seated woman with bared shoulders, gently tending to her wounds as onlookers gather close around them. Dim, warm light falls across the group from a window at left, deepening into near-total shadow toward the edges of the room.
items.tags: healing, charity, crown, dark interior, oil painting, devotional

items.title: Saint Hermenegild in Prison
items.description_narrative: A crowned figure stands bare-chested in a shadowy cell, gazing upward as one man grips a blade behind him and another kneels at his feet. Pale light filters through a barred window at left, the only illumination in the otherwise engulfing darkness.
items.tags: martyrdom, prison scene, crown, dark interior, oil painting, dramatic lighting

items.title: Time (Time and the Old Women)
items.description_narrative: Two elaborately dressed old women sit close together, one holding up a sign, while a winged figure looms behind them wielding a broom overhead. Their powdered faces and fine gowns contrast with the ghostly, grey figure poised to sweep them away. The painting depicts an allegory of Time.
items.tags: allegory, vanity, old age, oil painting, satire, dark humor

items.title: Monk Talking to an Old Woman
items.description_narrative: Two faces emerge from near-total darkness, pressed close together: a wild-eyed old woman in a blue headscarf and a gaunt man leaning toward her, mouth open as if mid-sentence. Loose, urgent brushwork gives their expressions a raw, unsettled intensity.
items.tags: portrait, dark background, expressive, character study, oil painting

items.title: Nantes, from the Île Feydeau
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Loire River tour, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Market women in white bonnets gather on the steps of a riverside quay, baskets of produce spread before them, while boats loaded with goods drift on the water below. Grand buildings and a church tower line the far bank, fading into a hazy, cloud-streaked sky.
items.tags: market scene, river quay, watercolor, cityscape, figures

items.title: The Burning of the Houses of Lords and Commons, 16 October 1834
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, sublime history painting, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Flames tear across the night sky above the river, their orange glare mirrored in the water below. Crowds gather in silhouette along the near bank to watch as boats drift past the burning skyline, smoke billowing over a distant bridge. The painting depicts the burning of the Houses of Parliament.
items.tags: fire, thames, night scene, disaster, oil painting, sublime, silhouette

items.title: Whalley Bridge and Abbey, Lancashire: Dyers Washing and Drying Cloth
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, topographical watercolor tradition, late 18th century
items.description_narrative: A three-arched stone bridge spans the river, its reflection nearly still in the shallow water below. Cattle wade near the far bank while cloth lies spread on the sandy shore to dry, tall umbrella pines rising against the sky at right.
items.tags: stone bridge, river, cattle, drying cloth, pastoral, trees

items.title: Bonneville, Savoy, with Mont Blanc
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Alpine Grand Tour, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Layered green mountains fall back toward a distant snow-capped peak, glimpsed through a gap in the range. A stone bridge of several arches spans the river before a small town clustered around a round tower, while sheep graze and two women rest on the near bank. The painting depicts the town of Bonneville in Savoy with Mont Blanc in the distance.
items.tags: alpine landscape, mont blanc, river valley, mountains, pastoral, stone bridge, grand tour

items.title: Dort, or Dordrecht: The Dort Packet-Boat from Rotterdam Becalmed
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Dutch marine tradition, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: A crowded sailing boat sits becalmed on glassy, golden water, its tall sails hanging slack under a hazy, cloud-streaked sky. A small rowboat glides alongside, while a distant town skyline barely breaks the horizon. The painting depicts the harbor at Dordrecht.
items.tags: becalmed, sailing boat, dutch harbor, golden light, marine art, oil painting

items.title: The Lake, Petworth: Sunset, Fighting Bucks
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Petworth House series, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Deer graze and wander across a wide parkland under a glowing, pastel sunset sky. A still lake reflects the fading light in the middle distance, framed by tall trees at either edge of the composition.
items.tags: deer, parkland, sunset, oil painting, pastoral, panoramic

items.title: The Red Rigi
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, late Swiss watercolors, mid-19th century
items.description_narrative: A mountain glows rosy pink against a pale sky, its slopes reflected in the still waters of the lake below. A small boat crowded with passengers crosses the foreground, its wake barely disturbing the glassy surface.
items.tags: mountain, sunrise, lake, watercolor, boats, alpine

items.title: Melrose Abbey
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Scottish Border antiquities, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: A horse-drawn cart pauses on a hillside overlooking a broad, winding river valley, while a group of top-hatted men rest among the trees at right. A hazy town spreads along the far bank beneath layered blue mountains, the whole scene bathed in soft midday light.
items.tags: river valley, panoramic landscape, watercolor, wagon, figures, atmospheric

items.title: Queen Mab's Cave
items.agent_name: Imitator of J. M. W. Turner
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, late imaginative landscape, mid-19th century
items.description_narrative: A ruined archway and hilltop fortress loom hazily over dark water, with pale, indistinct figures gathered at the shore below. Made after 1846 by an imitator of J. M. W. Turner, this oil on fabric is a reduced copy of a composition Turner exhibited that year.
items.tags: turner, imitator, ruins, fantasy landscape, romanticism, oil on fabric, gothic

items.title: Rockets and Blue Lights (Close at Hand) to Warn Steamboats of Shoal Water
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, late marine painting, mid-19th century
items.description_narrative: A brilliant flare bursts through a swirling, storm-darkened sky, its light reflected on the churning surf below. Figures gather on the shore at left, watching as ships struggle barely visible amid the waves and dark, whirling clouds above.
items.tags: storm, flare, seascape, oil painting, dramatic sky, maritime signal

items.title: Llanthony Abbey, Monmouthshire
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, picturesque ruin watercolors, late 18th century
items.description_narrative: A ruined stone abbey nestles at the foot of misty mountains, its broken arches still tracing the shape of its windows. A figure with a dog pauses on the rocks above a rushing stream, small against the scale of the wooded hillside.
items.tags: ruins, abbey, gothic, watercolor, mountains, picturesque

items.title: Caligula's Palace and Bridge
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, imaginary classical landscape, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Crumbling classical ruins rise out of a golden haze, their columns and archways silhouetted against a pale sky. Figures wade in the shallow water below while a seated woman rests beneath tall trees at right, the whole scene bathed in soft, atmospheric light.
items.tags: classical ruins, golden light, imaginary landscape, atmospheric, oil painting, romanticism

items.title: The Moselle Bridge, Coblenz
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Rhine and Moselle tour watercolors, mid-19th century
items.description_narrative: A long, multi-arched stone bridge stretches faintly across the river, its reflection barely traced in pale washes of pink and ochre. A hazy fortress rises at left while small boats drift near the far bank, all dissolving into a nearly blank, sunlit sky.
items.tags: watercolor, bridge, river, atmospheric, faint washes

items.title: Dido Building Carthage
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, classical history landscape, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: A hazy sun hangs low over a classical harbor, its light reflected in the still water between grand colonnaded buildings on either bank. Figures gather on the marble steps at left near ships moored in the port, while a tree-crowned promontory rises at right. The painting depicts the founding of Carthage by Dido.
items.tags: classical harbor, golden light, architecture, history painting, oil painting, atmospheric
items.credit_line: J.M.W. Turner, Michael Bockemühl, Taschen (Köln), 1992, ISBN 3-8228-0669-2

items.title: Devil's Bridge, St Gotthard's Pass
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Alpine sublime, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: A faint rainbow arcs through drifting mist above a steep, rocky gorge, its rugged cliffs rendered in warm ochre washes. Below, a mountain stream rushes over stones and fallen branches, the scene hazy with atmosphere and scale.
items.tags: watercolor, gorge, rainbow, alpine landscape, mist, mountain stream

items.title: Evening Landscape, with Castle and Bridge in Yorkshire
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Yorkshire patron commissions, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: A dark, arched stone bridge sits silhouetted beneath a looming, tree-covered hill, its shape dissolving into evening shadow. Warm light still glows faintly in the sky above, mirrored in the still water of the foreground.
items.tags: silhouette, twilight, stone bridge, watercolor, atmospheric

items.title: Calais Pier, with French Poissards Preparing for Sea: An English Packet Arriving
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, early marine painting, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Heavy swells toss fishing boats crowded with people against a wooden pier, their sails straining under a churning sky. A shaft of blue breaks through towering storm clouds above, while onlookers crowd the jetty's edge to watch the boats fight their way in. The scene depicts sailing vessels arriving at a pier during a storm.
items.tags: storm, seascape, pier, sailing boats, marine art, oil painting, choppy sea

items.title: Sun Rising through Vapour: Fishermen Cleaning and Selling Fish
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Dutch-inspired marine and genre painting, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: A hazy sun rises behind ships anchored offshore, its glow reflected in the calm, sandy shallows. On the beach at right, fishermen sort their catch beside baskets of fish while others look on from a weathered wooden pier.
items.tags: fishermen, sunrise, harbor, oil painting, coastal scene, marine art
items.credit_line: The Yorck Project (2002) 10.000 Meisterwerke der Malerei (DVD-ROM), distributed by DIRECTMEDIA Publishing GmbH. ISBN: 3936122202.

items.title: What You Will!
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, literary fancy picture, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Elegantly dressed figures in bonnets and fine gowns gather beneath autumn-toned trees around a garden statue and marble bust. Further back, sculpted figures embrace atop stone pedestals, the whole park bathed in soft, golden light.
items.tags: fete galante, park scene, figures, statues, oil painting, autumn

items.title: The Château de St. Michael, Bonneville, Savoy
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Alpine Grand Tour, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: A weathered stone tower rises at the edge of a dirt road that winds toward layered mountains fading into haze. A woman rests against a low wall in the foreground shade, dwarfed by the scale of the valley and the billowing clouds above. The painting depicts mountains and trees near Bonneville.
items.tags: mountain landscape, stone tower, alps, atmospheric, oil painting, romanticism

items.title: Lausanne: Sunset
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, late Swiss tour watercolors, mid-19th century
items.description_narrative: A spired cathedral glows deep orange against a hazy sunset sky, its silhouette rising above a bustling market crowd rendered in loose, warm washes. Trees darken at left while a gentle hillside slopes away to the right.
items.tags: sunset, cathedral, watercolor, market scene, atmospheric

items.title: Tummel Bridge, Perthshire
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Scottish Highlands tour, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: A two-arched stone bridge spans a shallow, rock-strewn river beneath dark, roiling storm clouds. Cattle wade in the shallows at right while figures pick their way among boulders in the foreground, dwarfed by the surrounding hills.
items.tags: stone bridge, highlands, storm clouds, watercolor, river landscape

items.title: Geneva, the Jura Mountains and Isle Rousseau, Sunset
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, late Swiss tour watercolors, mid-19th century
items.description_narrative: A small tree-covered island sits at the center of a still lake, its reflection dissolving into golden light. Hazy blue mountains rise beyond, while distant sailboats and quiet figures near a quayside are washed in the soft glow of sunset.
items.tags: sunset, lake, watercolor, mountains, island, atmospheric

items.title: The Sun of Venice Going to Sea
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, late Venetian marine painting, mid-19th century
items.description_narrative: A gondola's painted sail, marked with a golden sun, catches the light as it glides across still, honey-colored water. Venice's towers dissolve into haze on the horizon, while smaller boats drift on either side beneath a pale, luminous sky.
items.tags: venice, sailboat, golden light, oil painting, atmospheric, marine art

items.title: Panoramic View of the Thames
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, early topographical watercolor, late 18th century
items.description_narrative: Seen from a high vantage point, the river winds below a multi-arched bridge, its banks lined with trees and scattered houses. A tall dark tree and a fence trace the near ridge, framed beneath a vast, cloud-filled sky.
items.tags: panoramic view, river, watercolor, bridge, landscape

items.title: The Rainbow: Osterspai and Filsen
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Rhine tour watercolors, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: A vivid rainbow arcs over a wide river valley, spanning from dark storm clouds at left to sunlit hills at right. Figures gather on the near bank beside a small moored boat, the wet sand reflecting the muted colors of the sky.
items.tags: rainbow, river landscape, watercolor, storm, atmospheric

items.title: East Cowes Castle, the Seat of J. Nash, Esq.: The Regatta Beating to Windward
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, yachting and marine painting, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Billowing pale sails crowd a choppy stretch of sea, one yacht heeling hard as it beats to windward past a scatter of smaller boats. A red buoy bobs in the foreground surf, while distant masts and low buildings blur along the horizon. The scene depicts a yacht regatta near East Cowes Castle.
items.tags: regatta, sailing yachts, seascape, marine art, oil painting

items.title: View off Margate, Evening
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, late coastal watercolors, mid-19th century
items.description_narrative: A small boat with a golden sail cuts through calm, muted waters near the shore, a larger ship's silhouette barely visible in the distance. Figures and a dog gather on the sandy beach at right, the whole scene washed in soft, overcast light.
items.tags: seascape, sailboat, beach, evening light, coastal scene

items.title: The Schöllenen Gorge from the Devil's Bridge, Pass of St Gotthard
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, late Swiss Alpine tour watercolors, mid-19th century
items.description_narrative: A narrow, arcaded roadway clings to a sheer rock face, winding above a plunging gorge choked with mist. Towering cliffs press in from both sides, their jagged silhouettes nearly swallowed by heavy cloud.
items.tags: gorge, mountain pass, watercolor, alpine, atmospheric

items.title: Tours: Sunset, Looking Backwards
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Loire River tour watercolors, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: A riverside street bustles with figures and a loaded donkey beside tall, sun-faded buildings, while covered barges crowd the water's edge. A hazy sun glows low over the river, silhouetting a distant bridge and cathedral spires.
items.tags: riverside town, watercolor, figures, boats, atmospheric

items.title: Scarborough Town and Castle: Morning, Boys Catching Crabs
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, England and Wales coastal watercolors, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Children crouch together on the wet sand, poking at a tide pool while a masted ship rests beached at right, figures moving around its hull. Rocky cliffs rise at left, where laundry hangs to dry, and a distant hilltop ruin overlooks the town across the bay.
items.tags: coastal scene, watercolor, children, beach, ship, castle ruins

items.title: Kirkby Lonsdale Churchyard
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, topographical antiquarian illustration, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Children play among weathered gravestones in the foreground, one boy crouching to hold another as the group laughs beneath a canopy of trees. Beyond the churchyard wall, a river winds through a hazy valley toward distant blue hills.
items.tags: churchyard, children playing, river valley, watercolor, topographical, pastoral

items.title: Bell Rock Lighthouse
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, maritime engineering subject, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Waves crash violently against the Bell Rock Lighthouse, spray leaping past its lantern room, while a small sailing ship struggles through the storm nearby. Dark, turbulent clouds and churning water dwarf the tower on all sides. The watercolor depicts the lighthouse standing in the North Sea.
items.tags: lighthouse, storm, seascape, watercolor, sailing ship, dramatic waves

items.title: The Evening of the Deluge
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, late color-theory series, mid-19th century
items.description_narrative: A dense flock of birds streams across a hazy, glowing sun, swirling above a shadowy landscape thick with mist. A serpentine creature rises from the water at right, while huddled figures shelter beneath a dark, tent-like form below.
items.tags: apocalyptic, swirling composition, atmospheric, biblical, oil painting, late style

items.title: The Bass Rock
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Scottish coastal watercolors, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: A storm-darkened sky presses down on the Bass Rock, its pale cliffs rising sheer from a churning sea. In the foreground, a small boat battles the waves, dwarfed by the looming rock and gathering clouds.
items.tags: seascape, storm, watercolor, rock formation, coastal, dramatic sky

items.title: Ancient Rome: Agrippina Landing with the Ashes of Germanicus
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, imaginary classical reconstruction, early 19th century
items.description_narrative: Classical temples and a great arched bridge dissolve into a golden, sunlit haze above a crowded river landing. Boats and figures cluster along the near bank, while veiled figures in pale robes stand apart on steps at right, their color a sharp note in the otherwise dreamlike scene. Turner painted this imagined view of ancient Rome as a history painting.
items.tags: ancient rome, golden light, river, classical architecture, history painting, romanticism, atmospheric

items.title: Saint-Maurice, Valais
items.cultural_context: English Romanticism, Alpine tour watercolors, early-to-mid 19th century
items.description_narrative: A single stone arch carries a small chapel-topped bridge across a rocky gorge, dark rock rising sharply on one side. A wading bird stands in the shallow stream below, dwarfed by the terraced mountainside stretching into the distance.
items.tags: watercolor, stone bridge, gorge, alpine landscape, mountain pass
